changes: MIDI Scenes is back, rebuilt: hold SCENE A or B and turn a knob on a MIDI track to lock it, and the crossfader morphs the locks and sends them as CCs.
Locks are saved with the project in their own file, so LFO designer shapes are no longer touched. Projects saved with MIDI Scenes 0.2 are converted the first time they load.
Works beside other modules. Needs Modwerk base 0.7.4 or newer, loaded over USB.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
